name: univms
description: Multi-vendor video management client for Hikvision NVRs/DVRs and DW Spectrum servers: live view grids, playback, PTZ, events, e-maps and device maintenance.
author: SightWatch <mike@sightwatch.com>

scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.js win32 x64 && node scripts/release-notes.js && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.js linux x64 && node scripts/release-notes.js && electron-builder --linux dir --x64 --publish never && node scripts/package-linux.js
scripts.dist: npm run dist:win && npm run dist:linux
